name: Mont Mbapit
description: An ancient volcano in the western region, home to an impressive crater lake with steep, vertical rock walls.
bonASavoir: The actual cost: A community tax of approximately 1,000 to 2,000 FCFA is collected in the village of Koupa-Matapit to access the constructed stairs leading to the crater lake. The reality on the ground: As the site is very isolated and surrounded by local legends, it is strongly recommended to hire a guide from the village. Agencies in the west offer guided day trips for around 35,000 FCFA.
